text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow didn't seem to be 
feeling well, so I decided to let her rest 
in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I'll be back on my feet in 
no time, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Mmm... Huh? Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A run-in! A surprise!? Mahrvelous☆★ 
Bubble, you can come along too~~~☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous!? What's with that outfit—wait, 
me too!? Where on earth are we...?

text_block_list.name: Dreamyu
text_block_list.text:
Myu-myu! Are you awake-myu~? Nice to meet 
you, I'm Bubble-myu~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? The plushie... talked...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
They're not plushies☆ They're fairies♪ 
Looks like these little cuties want to be 
friends with Bubble★☆★

text_block_list.name: Love-Babu
text_block_list.text:
Luvyu~, did we scare you, luv? But, but! 
We're not suspicious folks at all, luvvv~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I see, I believe you! Let's be friends!

text_block_list.name: Fairies
text_block_list.text:
Myu!? Is it okay-myu? Luv!? Is it 
okay-luv?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course! There's no way cuties like them 
could be suspicious!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I can tell just by looking at your eyes 
that you're good kids. Those big eyes like 
strawberry jelly... ♡ Yep! I believe in 
you guys!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We did it, you two! Having friends is 
marvelous☆★☆ Believing is 
marveeeeelous★☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right! First up, sliding down that 
rainbow!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Wait for me~!! Ahahaha♪ Ufufufu♪ 
Ahahaha—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaaaare.*

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous? H-Huh, was it a dream...!? Um, 
were you staying by my side the whole 
time?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun! The fluffy cloud pool♪ 
Ahahaha! Ahahahahahaーーー☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...? I can't quite remember, but...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I feel like I just had a super fun dream!
